answer: Here is one mechanism that works: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because cedar only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, lantern is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any wander approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
